# dark-app-factory
> **"Software Factories for the Rest of Us."** A local-first, low-cost implementation of the "Software Factory" methodology (Spec -> Scenarios -> Agent Loop). Inspired by [StrongDM Factory](https://fact...

This project includes automated llms.txt generation for AI accessibility.
